summary: Owlet, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a new asset-based revolving credit facility with Wells Fargo, refinancing existing debt from ABL OPCO and WTI lenders. The facility provides up to $25M (expandable to $35M) with SOFR plus 2.00%-2.25% margin, maturing in three years. A $17.063M initial draw repaid prior borrowings. Covenants are standard for such facilities. This is a routine debt refinancing and not a special situation event.
